base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: the heavy round copper front door of the lighthouse opening onto a windswept cliff-top doorstep, with the Stink-o-Meter mounted beside it. Lighting: bright, breezy daylight.
In the shot: Duggie, an enormous, lovable Golden Retriever with shining coin-gold fur smeared with bog mud and river silt, one blade of grass stuck to his head, extraordinarily long floppy ears that flap like wings, huge soulful golden-brown eyes, a giant wagging tail, and a small swarm of cartoon flies circling his head in tight synchronised formation; the Grumpy Glitch-Bots, boxy grey rectangular robots shaped like small filing cabinets on stubby metal legs, each with a small speaker grille for a mouth, a single blinking red sensor eye, and a chest panel covered in rows of grey buttons; they move stiffly in rigid formation; twelve small red squirrels with enormous bushy tails, wide anxious eyes, and the look of creatures absolutely ready to bite something.
Camera: Close on Duggie, then a stylised flashback.
Action: Duggie snaps back to fast mode and as he babbles, a desaturated storybook flashback appears: a big grey spaceship shaped like a filing cabinet beams twelve squirrels up off the cliff.
Dialogue: Duggie (goofy, warm, slightly gravelly young male voice; in FAST mode a breathless machine-gun stutter of words; in SLOW mode a deep, stretched, slowed-down drawl as if recorded at quarter speed, FAST mode) says: "THE GRUMPY GLITCH BOTS TOOK THEM! A big grey ship shaped like a FILING CABINET!"
Sound effects: tractor-beam hum, squirrel squeaks, dusting swishes, server beeps, ambience of wind, waves, door creak.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
extension_prompt:
Continue this exact shot seamlessly: same characters, same designs, same setting, same lighting and same 3D animated style (Duggie, The Grumpy Glitch-Bots, The Twelve Squirrels).
Action: The flashback shows grey Glitch-Bots using the squirrels' bushy tails as feather-dusters on rows of blinking computer servers.
Dialogue: Duggie (goofy, warm, slightly gravelly young male voice; in FAST mode a breathless machine-gun stutter of words; in SLOW mode a deep, stretched, slowed-down drawl as if recorded at quarter speed, FAST mode) says: "They said the tails were UNAUTHORIZED FLUFFINESS to dust their SERVERS!"
Sound effects continue: tractor-beam hum, squirrel squeaks, dusting swishes, server beeps.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
negative_prompt: live action, photorealistic humans, 2D flat animation, anime, sketch, subtitles, captions, on-screen text, watermark, logo, distorted faces, extra limbs, extra fingers, flicker, background music
